maria-ross: opened two related PRs migrating the cost heatmap example to the cost-attribution API and renaming tracing param from `trace_id` to `trace_hex`. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4124. Can reviewers sanity-check py/js/rust snippets and the dashboard anchor?
devon: taking a look. Python snippet failed lint in CI; we were still passing `trace_id` into ConsoleClient. Quick fix: ```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient(trace_hex="abcdef1234")
```
aj: JS sample needs `traceKey` -> `trace_hex`. We usually normalize: ```js
function normalizeTraceKey(k){ return k.replace(/-/g,''); }
client = new ConsoleClient({ trace_hex: normalizeTraceKey(rawKey) })
```
docs-ci-bot: docs build failed: broken link to https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/#/overview?anchor=heatmap-alloc (404). Linkcheck output: Error: anchor not found in /docs/console/observability/heatmap.md: line 72.
leo: I can take the JS patch and push. Tagging @aj for naming review.
maria-ross: the heatmap example references an old internal dashboard slug. Who can confirm current anchor?
devon: updated slug to `heatmap-cost-attribution` in the console; anchor should be heatmap-cost-attribution. I pushed a docs-only commit to 4123 (commit 6a1b3f2).
aj: re-ran linkcheck locally; our linkchecker treats query-stringed anchors weirdly. Suggest wrapping the URL in angle brackets: `<https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/#/overview?anchor=heatmap-cost-attribution>` or use a reference-style link.
maria-ross: will switch to angle brackets. Also add a small migration snippet showing before/after for `trace_id` -> `trace_hex` and include a curl smoke test.
devon: curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/trace -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"trace_hex":"abcdef1234","events":[]}'
```
aj: add a note about JSON quoting on Windows: "On Windows, use single quotes for JSON payloads or escape double quotes." :warning:
docs-reviewer: review notes: update heatmap screenshot (legend changed). If screenshot not ready, mark as deferred in PR and add a follow-up TODO in migration guide. Also please add an SDK parity checklist (py/js/rust) to PR body.
maria-ross: I can generate the new screenshot later and attach. Marked screenshot update as deferred in PR 4123.
devon: patched python snippet and switched to angle-bracket link, pushed commit 6a1b3f3.
